analysis.contract_runtime_binding: conditioning-map-export contract v1.0 binds to runtime_bridge_contract; maps route through adapter_runtime_binding before any backend target selection.
analysis.adapter_runtime_binding: controlnet_adapter and comfyui_adapter translate export maps to backend-specific slots; comfyui_adapter is recommended primary adapter per translation validation.
analysis.fallback_runtime_binding: When adapter or backend binding fails, fallback_runtime_binding activates ConditionedPromptBuilder with NOT_PRODUCTION_REPLICA — architecture validated, not executed.
analysis.runtime_bridge_traceability: traceability_signature links source_contract, adapter, and runtime_target with runtime_degradation_path for audit without GPU execution.
analysis.runtime_capability_assessment: Per-backend runtime_capability_level reports what CAN connect at architecture level; identity and temporal domains remain false until GPU validation phase.

runtime_bridge_contract.bridge_mode: architecture_validation_only — validates Can Connect?, not Can Reconstruct Movies?
runtime_bridge_contract.runtime_connected: false — bridge architecture defined only; no live backend socket opened.
runtime_bridge_contract.backend_executed: false — no GPU raster generation or inference in this phase.
runtime_bridge_contract.adapter_gate: Maps must pass adapter_runtime_binding before runtime_target assignment.

runtime_execution_path.execution_deferred: true — path defined for connection readiness; execution blocked until GPU validation.

runtime_fallback_path.preserves: Narrative text constraints and scene_remap gonegi_scene_id.

runtime_traceability_format.traceability_id: Unique runtime bridge traceability record identifier.
runtime_traceability_format.source_contract: Source contract path (conditioning-map-export or image_app ingestion contract).
runtime_traceability_format.runtime_target: Backend target enum: controlnet_backend | comfyui_backend | future_video_backend.
runtime_traceability_format.traceability_signature: Deterministic hash binding source_contract, adapter, and runtime_target.
runtime_traceability_format.runtime_degradation_path: Ordered adapter and fallback steps when runtime degrades.

runtime_capability_format.runtime_capability_level: Per-domain boolean capability map at architecture validation time.
runtime_capability_format.environment_identity: Environment reference bank IP-Adapter path connectable.
runtime_capability_format.object_identity: Object reference bank IP-Adapter path connectable.
runtime_capability_format.temporal_preservation: Temporal memory and video backend connectable.
runtime_capability_format.assessment_note: Capability true means architecture supports connection; false means blocked or deferred — not a reconstruction readiness score.

runtime_limitations: No GPU execution in this phase — architecture validation only.
environment_identity and object_identity require IP-Adapter nodes not yet connected.
temporal_preservation requires future_video_backend deferred per architecture decision.
raster control maps not generated — metadata binding only.
runtime_connected=false — bridge defined but not live-connected to backend.
